Leaker Evan Blass has just published a post claiming the iPhone Ultra will arrive in three colors, including a surprising red option.

Update: Mark Gurman has posted on X claiming the iPhone Ultra will NOT come in red, directly contradicting Blass. His original post is below.

Evan Blass claims iPhone Ultra could come in red

With the iPhone launch event officially scheduled for September 9, rumors about Apple's next-generation flagship iPhones continue to surface. The latest concerns the color options for the foldable iPhone Ultra.

It has largely been assumed that the iPhone 18 Pro will come in a deep cherry/burgundy color, a light blue, silver, and possibly Space Gray among others.

However, rumors suggest the iPhone Ultra might only come in black and white, or potentially even just white.

However, leaker Evan Blass has now posted on X claiming there will also be a red option among them.

The image above appears to be AI-generated. For instance, the iOS 27 status bar in the image contains inconsistencies, such as still using the older iOS 26 battery icon design.

That said, the image may be AI-generated, which doesn't necessarily mean the color information is incorrect.

We're skeptical because there have been no credible rumors of an iPhone Ultra in red before now. It would also be unusual for both flagship models to offer a red option, so this rumor should be taken with a grain of salt.

Either way, Apple's plans will be revealed in two weeks.

What do you think of the rumored iPhone Ultra colors? Let us know in the comments.
